newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines gets Duff and Phelps credit upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Philippines gets Duff and Phelps credit upgrade.

text.p: Duff and Phelps Credit Rating Co has raised the rating on the Philippines' foreign currency obligations by one notch to BB+ from BB, Finance Secretray Roberto de Ocampo said on Monday.
The new rating comes on the heels of recent upgrades by other rating agencies such as Standard and Poor's, Moody's, and Japan Credit Rating Agency over the last four months.

"While the credit rating upgrade recognises the country's most recent economic achievements, more noteworthy is the assignment of a positive outlook, as it indicates solid confidence on the country's capacity to further accelerate progress in improving its economic fundamentals," de Ocampo said.
Finance officials said a credit upgrade would broaden access for local borrowers to long-term foreign financing and lower their cost of funding.
De Ocampo said the next credit rating upgrade would likely come after the 1998 presidential election.
